subject: City Council Newsletter
overview: The committee approved the initial draft and rotation schedule for a monthly City Council newsletter and created a subcommittee to plan community listening sessions.

items.title: Modernizing Council Communications and Outreach Strategy
items.summary: The committee approved an edited draft and drafting schedule for a City Council newsletter and voted to consult with the Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion director on distribution methods, over concerns from Councilor Scarpelli that outreach plans for underserved residents were not sufficiently developed.

items.title: Establishment of City Council Listening Sessions
items.summary: Approved a motion to establish a subcommittee composed of Councilors Callahan, Tseng, and Leming to plan monthly community listening sessions targeting various civic and student groups.
